name: Homarids
description: An antarctic race of crustaceans that conquered Vodalia and later migrated to Terisiare.

description_citations.text: "Sarpadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The cooling climate lets Homarids attack Vodalia until the empire is overwhelmed.
timeline.quote: Their ceaseless attacks strained Vodalia's defenses to their limit, eventually overwhelming the empire.

citation.text: Vodalian Soldiers (Fallen Empires, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: After the Sylex Blast, the Homarids overrun much of the Vodalian territory.
timeline.quote: much of their territory was overrun by the Homarids

citation.text: "Merfolk", section "Vodalian Merfolk". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Urza activates the Golgothian Sylex the climate cools, crops fail, and strife breaks out between former allies; homarids encroach on merfolk waters.
timeline.quote: After Urza activated the Golgothian Sylex , the climate of the entire world rapidly cooled.

citation.text: "Sarpadia", section "Climate Change". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Icatia, weakened by the Farrelite Cult, finally falls to orcs, goblins, thrulls and thallids aided by Tevesh Szat, and Vodalia is conquered by homarids.
timeline.quote: The last empire to fall was Icatia

citation.text: "Sarpadia", section "Fall of the Empires". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Homarids migrate to Terisiare, where they cause flooding, later fading away.
timeline.quote: the Voda Sea continued to be dominated by homarids

citation.text: "Sarpadia", section "The Flood Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Old Vodalia is destroyed by raiding Homarids during the Fall of the Sarpadian Empires.
timeline.quote: was destroyed by raiding creatures called Homarids during the Fall of the Sarpadian Empires around 170 AR

citation.text: "Vodalia", section "Early Vodalia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: merfolk have waged bitter, generations-long wars against other subsurface peoples

citation.text: "Vodalia", section "Mending Era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
